mainText: From Times of Malta: Volunteers to receive legal protection for first time under proposed law. Reform aims to cut bureaucracy and ease reporting requirements for voluntary organisations

mainText: From Times of Malta: Specialist nurse to support people living with Parkinson’s in Malta. More than 2,000 people are receiving treatment for the condition

titleText: Over 2,000 people in Malta receiving treatment for Parkinson's Disease
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Over 2,000 people in Malta receiving treatment for Parkinson's Disease. More than 2,000 people in Malta are currently registered as receiving treatment for Parkinson's disease, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Health Ian Borg announced at the opening of the Advances and Challenges in Parkinson's Disease conference.

titleText: Refurbished hall inaugurated at Mikiel Anton Vassalli College in Ħamrun
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Refurbished hall inaugurated at Mikiel Anton Vassalli College in Ħamrun. Minister for Education and Sport Byron Camilleri inaugurated the newly refurbished hall at Mikiel Anton Vassalli College in Ħamrun following extensive modernization works carried out under the EDU Infrastructure programme, the government said Saturday.

titleText: PL President believes budget measures unintentionally stirred anti-foreigner sentiment
mainText: From MaltaToday: PL President believes budget measures unintentionally stirred anti-foreigner sentiment. Labour Party President Alex Sciberras believes government’s controversial budget measures targeting non-EU workers have “unintentionally” spread anti-foreigner sentiment.
